title: CertifiedImplementation
description: The subject of certification (ADR-064 D-064-01): an IMPLEMENTATION, identified by implementation_id plus the content hash of the exact artifact set tested (implementation_hash). Never an entity, brand or operator — 'declared_by' is attribution/contact only. A different build is a different subject and needs its own certification.

implementation_hash.description: Content hash of the exact artifact set; the certificate binds to THIS hash.

declared_by.description: Attribution/contact only — never the subject of the certificate. Use 'Operator A' style, never a commercial brand.
